_comment: Curated links directory for the Explore page. Lives in the repo (GitHub) — no database needed. Edit this file directly, commit, and it ships on the next deploy. Every entry: name, url, description, official (true = government/primary source, false = third-party), tag (Free/Freemium/Paid).
